text:
Sam: Hey team — kicking off the Rainier POC with CloudHealth. Goal: align success metrics, security gating, timeline. I dropped a quick agenda below. Can folks confirm availability for a 45m call Wed 10am PT? /cc @Priya @Eli

Priya: Wed 10 works for me. Quick note — customer wants committed throughput pricing for Dedicated, can we get a ballpark?

Eli: Can provide numbers: for 4x A10 GPUs baseline, estimate ~$12k/mo committed. I'll confirm with pricing ops. Also need expected qps and avg seq len to firm this up.

Diego (CloudHealth): Wed 10 works. They need data residency in eu-west-1 and SOC2 plus SCF questionnaire completed prior to data ingestion.

Riya (Security): I'll take SCF + vendor questionnaire. Diego — can you share the security contact and any specific control gaps?

Diego: security@cloudhealth.com. They also asked about KMS/HSM options and audit logs retention (90 days min).

Jasmine (Product): For success criteria suggest: 1) 95th latency < 600ms for 512-token inference, 2) inference accuracy >= 0.82 F1 on their eval set, 3) sustained throughput >= 8 rps. Also need a customer prompt set + negative-case examples.

Sam: Draft agenda (paste):

```
- Intros (5m)
- Use-cases & critical prompts (10m)
- Success metrics & eval plan (10m)
- Security gating & data flow (10m)
- Pricing options + committed capacity (5m)
- Next steps / owners (5m)
```

Sam: Action items before call: Diego to share sample prompts & security contact; Priya/Eli to prepare pricing + capacity options; Riya to list questionnaire deliverables.

Priya: For pricing, can we present two options: Hosted trial (pay-as-you-go) + 30k token credit, or Dedicated 3-mo commit with a 15% discount? I'll draft numbers and capex vs opex notes.

Eli: Also note model-variant fallbacks — suggest we demo a quantized 8-bit variant so cost/token drops ~40% for background loads. We'll include latency tradeoffs in slides.

Riya: On SCF timeline — I can return initial answers in 3 business days if we get vendor access. If they require HSM proof-of-concept, that pushes ~2 weeks.

Diego: Confirmed — security@cloudhealth.com can provide vendor access today and a prioritized questionnaire.

Sam: Great. I'll schedule the Wed 10 invite and attach this thread. Any other blockers?

Priya: Please add a billing owner to the invite — they will need to approve any commit.

Sam: Good call — adding Alex from Finance. Also attaching test harness link: https://redwood-internal/run/poc-harness — Diego please verify access before the call.

Diego: Access verified, can upload sample prompts to your path.

POC-bot: Reminder — upload customer prompt set to /pocs/rainier before call.

Sam: Thanks all, see you Wed. :thumbsup:
